query:
SELECT 
  name,
  COUNT(*) as nb_doublons,
  GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ', ') as ids,
  GROUP_CONCAT(IFNULL(cas_number, 'N/A') ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' | ') as cas_numbers
FROM molecules
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(name))
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY nb_doublons DESC, name
LIMIT 50;
